title: Olga Komadina Apraxia Therapy - Australia  - Videos
description:
Olga Komadina, Speech Pathologist, Specialising in treatment of Childhood Apraxia of Speech.  Producing FREE videos and resources designed to help parents, caregivers, teachers and health professionals identify the signs of apraxia and learn more about treatment methods such as Dynamic Temporal and Tactile Cueing (DTTC) (for treating early stages of aprasxia) and ReST Rapid Syllable Transition Training (later stages).

Connect with us on Instagram @olgakomadina_apraxia_therapy
https://www.instagram.com/olgakomadina_apraxia_therapy/?igsh=dmRxdHVtaXV6c3d5&utm_source=qr 
and on facebook @olgakomadina_apraxia_therapy
https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61559715846044

Located in the Albury Wodonga area.

www.olgakomadinapraxiatherapy.com.au
